questionText: One important factor to consider in meal planning is foods in season because
explanation: Foods in season are usually abundant and cheaper, thereby cutting down on the overall cost of meal preparation.

explanation: Accurately measuring ingredients ensures the proper consistency and texture of baked goods like rock buns.

questionText: Mrs. Mensah who is to prepare banku and grilled tilapia for her family's meal, marinated the fresh tilapia before grilling to enhance its
explanation: Marinating fish improves both its taste (flavor) and texture before cooking.

explanation: Drinking water regularly maintains proper fluid balance and hydrates the body.

questionText: The best kitchen knife for peeling oranges is the
explanation: A paring knife is small and nimble, making it ideal for peeling and intricate fruit or vegetable work.

questionText: Kofi went to a restaurant and selected a menu with individually priced dishes. The name of this kind of service is
explanation: An 'à la carte' menu features individually priced items from which customers can choose.

questionText: The proper arrangement of tools and equipment in the food laboratory enables Borketey to
explanation: Organizing workspace and tools efficiently saves time and physical energy during food preparation.

questionText: When steaming yakayake, a tight fitting lid is used to cover the saucepan in order to
options: enhance the flavour of the food.
explanation: A tight-fitting lid traps steam and maintains a consistent cooking temperature inside the saucepan.

questionText: Your headmistress is to organize a party for graduating students. She decided to use the buffet service style because
explanation: Buffet service is ideal when serving a large number of guests efficiently without requiring individual table service.

questionText: Kofi is using the freehand cutting technique to cut an outfit to be worn to a wedding. The most important factor to consider in his choice of fabric is
explanation: Fabric texture influences how well a garment drapes and behaves during freehand cutting and sewing.

questionText: An example of kitchen hygiene practice is
explanation: Washing hands thoroughly before handling food is a primary personal and kitchen hygiene practice to prevent contamination.

questionText: A young entrepreneur is always researching into how to improve product and skills to bring about change in an establishment. This young entrepreneur is described as being
explanation: An entrepreneur who constantly introduces improvements and creative changes is innovative.

questionText: A dressmaker is required to take body measurement to ensure that
explanation: Accurate body measurements ensure that the finished garment fits the wearer correctly.

questionText: In any business enterprise, assigning specific roles to workers
options: encourages them to be punctual at work.
encourages them to be regular at work.
explanation: Assigning specific duties fosters accountability and makes workers responsible for their tasks.

questionText: The basic ingredients used for the preparation of pouring batter to be used for fish fillet include
explanation: Pouring batter typically consists of flour, eggs, and milk or water.

questionText: Mrs. Obeng uses different types of knives in her kitchen everyday. The best way she can maintain the efficiency of the knives is to
options: store in a drawer after use.
explanation: Sharpening knives regularly preserves their cutting edge and ensures high efficiency during use.

questionText: Small colourful bits of food that make cooked food appealing are
explanation: Garnishes are decorative items added to food to enhance its visual appeal.

questionText: A suitable cutting tool used for neatening an open seam on a denim skirt is
explanation: Pinking shears cut zigzag edges that prevent fabrics like denim from fraying excessively along open seams.

questionText: A major equipment used to assemble parts of a garment is the
explanation: The sewing machine is the primary equipment used to stitch and assemble garment sections together.

questionText: Amina eats well, has enough sleep, has good posture, takes care of her body. She is said to be practising
explanation: Eating well, resting, and taking care of one's body constitute practicing a healthy lifestyle.

questionText: Craftsmen have been tasked to prepare an artefact for use in a household. Which of the following practices must not be encouraged in the workshop?
explanation: Using a mushroomed head chisel is dangerous because the head can splinter and cause injury; it must never be encouraged.

questionText: A welder is preparing to weld two pieces of metal together. The most appropriate equipment to protect the eye is
explanation: A welding face mask (or helmet) protects the eyes and face from intense UV light, sparks, and heat during welding.

questionText: A student is to produce an artefact using materials with consistent and predictable properties. Which type of material would be the best choice?
explanation: Resistant materials (such as metals and hard woods) possess consistent and predictable mechanical properties suitable for structured construction.

questionText: In designing a frying pan, the handle should be made of a material that ensures safety and ease of use. Wood would be a good choice of material for the handle because it is a
explanation: Wood is a poor conductor of heat (thermal insulator), preventing the handle from getting too hot to hold.

questionText: A football team was advised to purchase new sportswear made with modern materials because these materials
explanation: Modern/technical materials are engineered to have improved properties like breathability, moisture-wicking, and durability.

questionText: A metal worker intends to create a circular pattern on a metal sheet. The most appropriate tool for marking-out circular shape is
explanation: A pair of compasses (or scribing compass) is used to draw and mark out circles and arcs on sheet metal.

questionText: Figure 1 shows a container to be used for keeping waste on the school compound. The most suitable material to be used for making the container to be able to withstand the open environment is
explanation: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC / durable plastic) resists weather elements and corrosion in open outdoor environments compared to untreated wood or mild steel.

questionText: The most suitable mechanism for opening and closing the lid of the container in Figure 1 is
explanation: A foot pedal bin uses a lever mechanism to lift the lid when pressed.

questionText: A Career Technology student needs to construct a chair for use. It is important to take accurate measurement of the various parts before cutting to sizes in order to
explanation: Taking accurate measurements prevents errors and avoids unnecessary wastage of materials.

questionText: A woodworker is to construct a table in the workshop. The correct steps to follow in cutting a piece of wood into two is
options: gauge along the marked position and remove waste wood with rip saw.
mark-out position to be cut, pare off sloping grooves and cut with cross-cut saw.
measure and mark-out, gauge along the grain and saw with rip saw.
Measure and mark-out position to be cut, square line round and saw with cross-cut saw.
explanation: The correct procedure involves measuring and marking out, squaring lines around the stock, and sawing across the grain using a cross-cut saw.

questionText: The most suitable method of assembling the handle of a butcher's knife is by
explanation: Rivets are permanently used to firmly secure handle scales to the tang of a knife.

questionText: In designing and making a wooden chair, the suitable material for preparing the surface to receive final finish is
explanation: Abrasives (such as sandpaper) are used to smooth wood surfaces before applying finishes.

questionText: Pillars are required during the construction of a building in order to resist
explanation: Pillars and columns support vertical loads by withstanding heavy compression forces.

questionText: Issaka is considering the type of joints to use in designing a wooden bookshelf. The aspect of the design process under consideration is
explanation: Choosing joint types falls under the construction phase of making an artefact.

questionText: Akweley has come up with variety of ideas in designing a new kitchen cabinet. It is important for her to write short notes on the ideas generated in order to
options: develop the selected idea into an acceptable shape.
indicate the reasons for accepting or rejecting an idea.
sketch final idea in pictorial view.
explanation: Annotating and writing notes on design ideas helps document reasons for accepting or rejecting specific design features.

questionText: An architect is working on a building plan. In drawing an inclined line, the most suitable instruments to be used are
explanation: Set-squares used alongside a tee-square allow drafting precise inclined and angled lines.

questionText: Your Career Technology teacher has assigned you to design and make a bottle opener. The first thing to do is to
options: cut the metal piece into the required sizes.
explanation: Preparing working drawings and designs is the initial formal stage after analyzing a design brief before manufacturing.

questionText: Two friends, Atta and Yaro, want to start a small scale money box producing business. Which of the following sources of capital is most appropriate for them?
explanation: Personal savings are typically the most accessible and appropriate starting capital for small-scale student or micro-enterprises.

questionText: Elinam is considering establishing a small scale metal fabrication business after graduating from JHS. The first step to consider is
explanation: Carrying out market research is essential to assess demand, competition, and feasibility before starting any business.
